copy.html:
It’s easy to play and win millions from the best lotteries here at LottosOnline. From the comfort of your own home, you can be in with a chance to win any of the world’s biggest jackpots. So, get the champagne on ice and find out more!

Choose and Play Lottos Online

Are you ready to learn how to play the lottery online? First, create your free LottosOnline account. It’s quick and simple, and there is absolutely no commitment. You can play as little or as often as you like.

When your account is up and running, you’re ready to enter into the lottery draw of your choice and play the lottery online. From the EuroMillions lottery to US Powerball, the choice is entirely yours.

To buy your lottery ticket for any big lottery draw, login to your account. Then follow the steps below.

  1. Select a lottery draw
  2. Choose your own numbers or let our Quick Pick random generator do it for you
  3. Add extra lines (optional)
  4. Buy your ticket as a once-off or a repeat entry
  5. Confirm your entry

And that’s it, you're playing the lottery!

Claiming Your Winnings

For total peace of mind, we always send clear email confirmation of your online lottery ticket entries which serves as your proof of purchase.

After the draw, we will inform you of any winnings via email. You can check the lottery results on our website too or set up automatic lottery results notifications. The faster you find out the good news, the better!

For most amounts your winnings will reflect in your Winnings Balance as soon as the draw has been processed. From here, you can transfer your winnings to your Account Balance to spend on more tickets, or you can follow the process to claim your winnings as cash. For larger winnings, we will contact you to arrange for you to collect your winning ticket in person.

If you have any questions, big or small, please get in touch. We are always happy to answer your queries. Good luck!
